title: Chat with Looker Studio Pro Reports
text:
Navigating complex Looker Studio dashboards to find specific data points is often time-consuming and disruptive to workflow. I can build a lightweight, integrated chat interface that allows your team to query report data in plain language, turning static visualizations into conversational insights without leaving the browser.

My approach focuses on clean architecture and reliable data access. I have experience building responsive, user-friendly chat systems, such as a menu-aware chatbot for a restaurant group that successfully handled order confirmations and staff handoffs (portfolio case study: WhatsApp order-taking chatbot). I have developed retrieval-augmented support assistants that process large knowledge bases, such as the helpdesk-rag project which handled a 3,000-page knowledge base (portfolio case study: Retrieval-augmented support assistant). This background ensures the interface will be robust and easy to use.

For this project, I will map your Looker Studio data structure to create a natural language query layer. I aim to deliver a functional prototype within the first week, followed by integration testing and final handover. I will ensure the system handles edge cases gracefully and provides clear, accurate responses. What specific metrics or report fields are most critical for your team to query daily?

title: Developer bij Squire
text: Squire needs a developer who can stabilize the existing codebase while shipping new features for students and companies. I bring seven years of full-stack experience, having built and maintained complex web platforms for healthcare and fintech clients. I built the ClinicQ booking system, creating online booking with reminders, waitlists, and a front-desk view (portfolio case study: Clinic appointment booking platform). I also developed the LedgerView dashboard, where I optimized cached queries to reduce daily ops review time (portfolio case study: Admin analytics dashboard). While my primary stack includes React and Node.js, I understand the architectural principles of Java and Angular well enough to contribute effectively to your platform. I am ready to dive into your codebase to identify bugs and implement improvements. How does your team currently handle code reviews and deployment cycles?

title: Python Tutor For Online Coding Course
text: Your students need to master beginner Python with a data analysis focus, moving beyond syntax to interpret real-world insights. I help learners build confidence by connecting code to tangible business outcomes. I have experience cleaning and manipulating data using Python libraries like Pandas, as demonstrated in the cohort-lens project (portfolio repository: cohort-lens README). My teaching approach breaks down statistical methods into manageable steps, ensuring students can tell a story with their data. I recently guided a project where I linked qualitative survey comments to quantitative scores, demonstrating how data drives decisions (portfolio case study: Customer survey analysis). I am comfortable adapting to your provided curriculum and delivering engaging remote lessons. I am available for the required 2-3 hours per week and can start immediately. What specific data visualization tools does your current curriculum prioritize for the heat map module?
